findings.label: Single-zone offset assumption
findings.detail: NTFL_UTC_OFFSET = "+09:30" is hard-coded for Australia/Darwin (no DST). Correct for every current NTFL grade, but a future grade in a DST-observing or different zone would compute a wrong kickoff and mis-window its candidates. Non-blocking: the code comment already documents the remedy (per-fixture schedule.timezone -> offset lookup inside scheduledKickoffMs).
